title: Human beta-Defensin 3 Inhibition of P. gingivalis LPS-Induced IL-1beta Production by BV-2 Microglia through Suppression of Cathepsins B and L.
authors: Inoue, Erika; Minatozaki, Shiyo; Shimizu, Sachi; Miyamoto, Sayaka; Jo, Misato; Ni, Junjun; Tozaki-Saitoh, Hidetoshi; Oda, Kosuke; Nonaka, Saori; Nakanishi, Hiroshi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究hBD3抑制Pg LPS诱导小胶质细胞IL-1beta产生的机制，涉及CatB/CatL和AlphaFold结构预测，但核心是炎症信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cathepsin B (CatB) is thought to be essential for the induction of Porphyromonas gingivalis lipopolysaccharide (Pg LPS)-induced Alzheimer's disease-like pathologies in mice, including interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) production and cognitive decline. However, little is known about the role of CatB in Pg virulence factor-induced IL-1beta production by microglia. We first subjected IL-1beta-luciferase reporter BV-2 microglia to inhibitors of Toll-like receptors (TLRs), IkappaB kinase, and the NLRP3 inflammasome following stimulation with Pg LPS and outer membrane vesicles (OMVs). To clarify the involvement of CatB, we used several known CatB inhibitors, including CA-074Me, ZRLR, and human beta-defensin 3 (hBD3). IL-1beta production in BV-2 microglia induced by Pg LPS and OMVs was significantly inhibited by the TLR2 inhibitor C29 and the IkappaB kinase inhibitor wedelolactonne, but not by the NLRPs inhibitor MCC950. Both hBD3 and CA-074Me significantly inhibited Pg LPS-induced IL-1beta production in BV-2 microglia. Although CA-074Me also suppressed OMV-induced IL-1beta production, hBD3 did not inhibit it. Furthermore, both hBD3 and CA-074Me significantly blocked Pg LPS-induced nuclear NF-kappaB p65 translocation and IkappaBalpha degradation. In contrast, hBD3 and CA-074Me did not block OMV-induced nuclear NF-kappaB p65 translocation or IkappaBalpha degradation. Furthermore, neither ZRLR, a specific CatB inhibitor, nor shRNA-mediated knockdown of CatB expression had any effect on Pg virulence factor-induced IL-1beta production. Interestingly, phagocytosis of OMVs by BV-2 microglia induced IL-1beta production. Finally, the structural models generated by AlphaFold indicated that hBD3 can bind to the substrate-binding pocket of CatB, and possibly CatL as well. These results suggest that Pg LPS induces CatB/CatL-dependent synthesis and processing of pro-IL-1beta without activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome. In contrast, OMVs promote the synthesis and processing of pro-IL-1beta through CatB/CatL-independent phagocytic mechanisms. Thus, hBD3 can improve the IL-1beta-associated vicious inflammatory cycle induced by microglia through inhibition of CatB/CatL.
abstract_zh: 组织蛋白酶B（Cathepsin B, CatB）被认为对于诱导小鼠中牙龈卟啉单胞菌脂多糖（Porphyromonas gingivalis lipopolysaccharide, Pg LPS）引起的阿尔茨海默病样病理变化至关重要，包括白细胞介素-1β（interleukin-1beta, IL-1beta）产生和认知衰退。然而，关于CatB在Pg毒力因子诱导小胶质细胞产生IL-1beta中的作用知之甚少。我们首先将IL-1beta-荧光素酶报告基因BV-2小胶质细胞暴露于Toll样受体（Toll-like receptors, TLRs）、IkappaB激酶和NLRP3炎症小体的抑制剂，随后用Pg LPS和外膜囊泡（outer membrane vesicles, OMVs）进行刺激。为阐明CatB的参与，我们使用了多种已知的CatB抑制剂，包括CA-074Me、ZRLR和人β-防御素3（human beta-defensin 3, hBD3）。Pg LPS和OMVs诱导的BV-2小胶质细胞中IL-1beta产生被TLR2抑制剂C29和IkappaB激酶抑制剂wedelolactonne显著抑制，但不受NLRPs抑制剂MCC950影响。hBD3和CA-074Me均显著抑制了Pg LPS诱导的BV-2小胶质细胞中IL-1beta产生。尽管CA-074Me也抑制了OMV诱导的IL-1beta产生，但hBD3并未抑制此过程。此外，hBD3和CA-074Me均显著阻断了Pg LPS诱导的核NF-kappaB p65转位和IkappaBalpha降解。相反，hBD3和CA-074Me并未阻断OMV诱导的核NF-kappaB p65转位或IkappaBalpha降解。进一步地，特异性CatB抑制剂ZRLR以及shRNA介导的CatB表达敲低对Pg毒力因子诱导的IL-1beta产生均无影响。有趣的是，BV-2小胶质细胞对OMVs的吞噬作用诱导了IL-1beta产生。最后，AlphaFold生成的结构模型表明，hBD3可以结合到CatB的底物结合口袋，也可能结合CatL。这些结果表明，Pg LPS通过CatB/CatL依赖性途径诱导pro-IL-1beta的合成和加工，而不激活NLRP3炎症小体。相比之下，OMVs通过CatB/CatL非依赖的吞噬机制促进pro-IL-1beta的合成和加工。因此，hBD3通过抑制CatB/CatL，可以改善小胶质细胞诱导的与IL-1beta相关的恶性炎症循环。
